acceptance.note: A case passes only if every declared metric is within its own tolerance at every level AND the level-series converges (span <= 3%, monotone where >=3 levels exist). Statuses are passed / failed / pending; `pending` never hides a machine FAIL, and `failed` entries keep their root cause.

slots.lineage: 4. 湍流槽道 (turbulent channel, Moser DNS)

cases.title: Lid-driven cavity Re=100 vs Ghia 1982 centreline table
cases.scope: 2-D incompressible cavity, MRT + pre-streaming bounce-back; centreline profile deviation and vortex centre at two grids.
cases.notes: Frozen verified artifact; the matrix re-checks the recorded error and the two-grid span, it does not re-run the 159 s/192 s simulations.

cases.title: Circular cylinder Re=100 vs Braza 1986 experiment (Cd, St)
cases.scope: 2-D free-stream cylinder with sponge outflow, D=48/64, seeded shedding. Cd and St against the Braza band.
cases.notes: Errors are read from the verified artifact's own bookkeeping (grids.D48/D64 .err_pct/.st_err_pct), which uses the Braza band Cd=1.35+-0.05 and the St band 0.164-0.165 with the band LOWER bound as denominator (St=0.160 -> -2.4%). Against the band midpoint 0.165 the D64 St error would be -3.03%, i.e. marginally outside the 3% gate; that convention sensitivity is recorded here rather than hidden. Cd error is not monotone (-1.53% -> -2.55%) although both levels stay inside the gate.

cases.title: Sphere Re=100 drag vs Schiller-Naumann
cases.scope: D3Q19, BFL interpolated smooth wall, per-link momentum ledger; D=40/60.
cases.notes: Recorded errors +2.771% / +2.540% (span 0.231%), monotone decreasing by the case README; the machine check uses the frozen cd_by_grid values.

cases.title: Turbulent channel Re_tau=180 vs Moser DNS (u+ profile)
cases.scope: 3-D periodic channel, D3Q19 natural KBC, Guo body force; u+ RMS error in y+ in [30,100].
cases.blocker: TERMINAL honest FAIL (benchmarks/pending/channel_turb_3d/README.md): root cause = domain size too small + insufficient statistical sample; the u+ RMS error in the log layer never reaches the 3% gate. The tabular Moser DNS anchor is also not frozen in-repo, so the anchor itself is WITHHELD.
cases.notes: Missing artifact paths are reported as pending-with-reason by the runner, never as passed. This slot exists to keep the negative result visible in the matrix.

cases.title: 2-D Taylor-Green vortex decay vs analytic gamma = 2 nu k^2
cases.scope: D2Q9 periodic box; velocity decay rate fitted over two independent halves of the run (temporal split, not a grid refinement).
cases.notes: Levels are two independent halves of the energy-decay fit (temporal split). Reference = analytic gamma_E = 4 nu k^2, frozen in the artifact as gamma_e_theory; the velocity-rate cross-check (-0.0007%) is recorded in the case README. Two-grid convergence for this slot is carried by case_taylor_green_3d.

cases.title: Static SCMP droplet: Laplace law + resolution convergence (CI tier)
cases.scope: 2-D Shan-Chen single-component droplet, G_lib=+5 (physical G_eff=-5), tau=1, three radii per level, domain L=4R periodic. Measured levels: R=8/12/16 and R=12/16/20. Not covered: 3-D sphere (standard tier).
cases.notes: HONEST FAIL of the CI tier, root cause quantified: with the uniform 3% Laplace gate the R=8/12/16 set fails (per-radius sigma deviation 4.689%, fit R^2=0.9961) while the R=12/16/20 set passes (0.822%, R^2=0.999984). R=8 is only two interface widths (W=4 in the SCMP model) and lies below the resolvable radius R >= 3W required for the Laplace law, so the coarse set is outside the model's validity range rather than evidence against it. The two-level span criterion also fails (3.87%) for the same single reason. Next build: gate R=12/16/20 and R=16/20/24, keep R=8/12/16 as a documented non-gated ladder. No threshold was relaxed and no artifact was edited.

cases.title: Rayleigh-Taylor linear growth rate vs viscous dispersion relation
cases.scope: SCMP pseudo-potential D2Q9 and an earlier VOF track; single-mode interface, growth rate fitted on a linear window.
cases.blocker: Honest FAIL with root cause (benchmarks/pending/rayleigh_taylor/README.md): over 10 (lambda, g) cases the SCMP pseudo-potential model has NO growth window inside the reachable parameter surface (sigma_sim <= 0 or NaN; lambda=280/g=6.5e-6 already at 91% of the vapor-spinodal gravity ceiling), and the earlier VOF module track failed structurally. Two independent model classes fail -> the slot stays failed until a model class with a demonstrable window exists.
cases.notes: No artifact paths are declared: the negative evidence is the documented parameter-surface scan, so the runner reports 'declared failed' with the blocker text (never passed).

cases.title: Ritter 1892 dam-break self-similarity (CI tier)
cases.scope: 1-D shallow-water finite-volume dam break onto a dry bed, nx=200/400, t_end=5 sqrt(h0/g). Metrics: front law, mass closure, depth-profile L2 error. Not covered: 3-D LBM free-surface dam break (tracked separately).
cases.notes: CI tier judged as declared (profile L2 <= 5%): it FAILS at nx=200/400 (9.83% / 6.29%) while the front law passes and converges monotonically (+4.51% -> +2.56%). The resolution ladder recorded in the artifact (nx=800/1600) shows a first-order decrease (3.84% / 2.32%) crossing the 5% gate near nx~700: the CI tier is under-resolved for the profile metric, which is the honest root cause. The pre-existing standard-tier runner (nx up to 1600) reports front_err_mass up to 6.4%, i.e. it would fail the same 5% front gate, confirming that the gate/tier pairing needs re-calibration rather than the numbers being quietly relaxed.

cases.title: DARPA SUBOFF bare-hull resistance at Re=1000 vs Blasius flat plate
cases.scope: 3-D D3Q19 MRT SUBOFF hull, L=48/80 cells, mix50 friction formula; total drag coefficient vs the Blasius wetted-area anchor.
cases.notes: Pre-registered gate of the case (README): finest tier |err| <= 3% AND the error decreases with resolution. L=48 (-3.17%) is therefore informational and only L=80 (-1.15%) is gated; the monotone requirement is still checked over both levels.

cases.title: Ship wave resistance vs Michell thin-ship theory
cases.scope: Michell closed-form C_W(Fn), Kelvin wave geometry and hump/hollow; the LBM free-surface C_W vs Michell comparison is the primary criterion.
cases.blocker: WITHHELD (benchmarks/wave_wake_michell/REPORT.md): the primary criterion 'LBM free-surface C_W within 15% of Michell' was NOT obtained - the 3-D Koerner free-surface kernel measured 9.56 s/step at 4e5 cells, extrapolating to ~35 h for a lambda/dx>=20 Wigley case, outside the node budget. 2-D free-surface substitute: period error 8.8-13.8%. Reported as WITHHELD, not PASS.
cases.notes: Kept pending to make the missing wave-resistance evidence explicit in the matrix; the 3-D cost is the documented blocker.

cases.title: Circular cylinder Re=100 in a channel — Schäfer & Turek 1996 case 2D-2 (Cd, Cl amp, St, dp)
cases.scope: Confined DFG geometry (channel 2.2x0.41, D=0.1 at (0.2,0.2), blockage 0.244), parabolic inlet U_mean=1, p=0 outlet, D2Q9 MRT + half-way BB + Ladd momentum exchange, D=28/40 lattice cells per diameter.
cases.notes: Anchor = the DFG 2D-2 table; the free-stream Braza anchor of the sibling case cylinder_re100 (Cd=1.35) does NOT apply here (blockage 0.244 doubles the drag). Errors are vs the band midpoint: cd->3.23, st->0.30, cl_amp->1.00, dp->2.48 raw. dp is sampled at the nearest fluid columns (x=0.145/0.255) and extrapolated to the DFG x=0.15/0.25 (the probes lie on the digital cylinder surface); the raw nearest-column value is kept in the artifact for sensitivity. Provenance limit: NNFM vol.48 PDF was not reachable offline, so the bands are transcribed from the two in-repo registers cited in REFERENCE.md (declared there).
